record.one_liner: Consensus is a research paper search engine over 400M+ scholarly papers, exposed via a REST API and a hosted MCP server.
record.auth_notes: API keys are sent in the x-api-key header (REST) or as a Bearer token (MCP); per-user OAuth 2.0 is also offered for MCP clients. critic: confirmed; MCP platforms table lists OAuth for most clients and Bearer token for other clients.
record.access_notes: Keys are created from the API & MCP Dashboard. The Free plan includes 30 calls per month and has no trial gate. critic: confirmed self_serve_free; Free plan works but pagination, full text and citations return 403 until upgraded.
record.api_notes: REST endpoints cover search, threads, full text and citations/references; pagination, full text and citations need paid plans on the Free tier.
record.blocker_notes: critic: confirmed, no blocker; free tier is rate/feature limited only.

evidence.quote: Pass the key in the x-api-key header. Requests without a valid key return 401.
